description_en: Adds a scaling group as a resource to a resource group
description_zh: 将一个伸缩组作为资源加入一个资源组
kebab_example: aliyun ess change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id asg-bp17xb4x1vr29lgt0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2ckjqe30000 --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only scaling groups are supported. Set the value to scalinggroup
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。目前仅支持伸缩组，取值：scalinggroup
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group whose resource group you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 待更换资源组的伸缩组ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group to which you want to move the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 将伸缩组更改到新的资源组后，新资源组的ID
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id
